meta.method: 17 parallel web-research agents; every score carries the URL of a page fetched on 2026-09-04/05. No score was taken from model memory. Percentages are 0-100; Elo values are raw.

status_legend.data_found: at least one target-benchmark score verified from a live source
status_legend.no_data_found: model exists but no target-benchmark score could be verified from any fetched source
status_legend.not_found_or_unreleased: no evidence the model exists / not released as of 2026-09-04

provenance.method: rule-based classification of setting/source per entry; see transform_provenance.py

legend.measured: value from an independent run/leaderboard (third-party harness)
legend.self_reported: value authored by the model vendor (model card, blog, tech report, official chart)
legend.unknown: aggregator value with no provenance note in the source setting

provenance.note: self_reported entries were moved out of scores/other_benchmarks into self_reported / self_reported_other_benchmarks; kept entries carry a provenance field.

models_scores_emptied.note: these models have only self-reported target-benchmark data; scores is empty, see self_reported
